title: The Smile of the Future Doctor
subtitle: Dr. Karim & Dr. Leila are counting on you
synopsis:
Welcome, Doctor! 🎓🦷

Dr. Karim has just earned his dental medicine degree. He is proud, but also terrified. 'What if I'm not up to it? What if I make mistakes? What if I can't find patients?'

Dr. Leila, an experienced dentist, takes him under her wing. 'Karim, what you're feeling is called impostor syndrome. It affects 70% of new graduates. But you will succeed.'

Between choosing assistantship or immediate practice setup, financing the practice, patient management, administrative aspects, and fear of failure, the path is full of obstacles.

A wrong choice, a hasty decision, and stress sets in. Good preparation, wise advice, and the young doctor flourishes.

The future of young dentists, their confidence, their success rest on YOUR shoulders.
